incipit_statement: Believe me, if all those endearing young charms, / Which I gaze on so fondly to-day, / Were to change by to-morrow, and fleet in my arms, / Like fairy-gifts fading away
preferred_title: BELIEVE ME, IF ALL THOSE ENDEARING / YOUNG CHARMS. / Air – My lodging is on the cold Ground
